# Foxglove Receiving Shipment Log — 04/18/2026
Inbound exception record | Dock 3 | Log ID FG-041826-07

## Shipment details
- Received: 04/18/2026 at 09:20 by Gordon Castillo
- Supplier: Foxglove Supply Cooperative, Dayton, OH
- Carrier: Northline Freight, PRO 7842196
- Purchase order: PO-66218 | Destination: Foxglove warehouse, 1810 Mill Creek Road, Columbus, OH
- Freight bill charge: $486.00; billed weight: 1,240 lb

## Count and condition
| Item | Expected | Received | Condition |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Ceramic planters, SKU CP-44 | 48 cartons | 48 cartons | 2 cartons crushed; 6 units broken |
| Steel shelving, SKU SS-10 | 12 cartons | 12 cartons | No visible damage |

- Lucas Ramos counted the cartons against PO-66218; carton quantities match the order.
- Photos of the crushed cartons and broken units were saved under FG-041826-07. The freight bill was marked "6 units broken" before Gordon Castillo signed for delivery.
- Damaged units were moved to the marked hold area and excluded from available inventory; 42 planters were entered as saleable stock.

## Space and follow-up
- Trailer usable capacity: 480 cu ft; this shipment occupied 162 cu ft. Remaining capacity: 328 cu ft.
- Carrier terms require written notice of visible damage within 5 calendar days of delivery and an itemized dollar value for damaged goods in the claim record.
- Follow-up: Wendy Gallagher will submit the carrier damage notice.
- Freight charge and damage quantities were entered in the receiving ledger on 04/18/2026; the invoice remains pending review against the purchase order.
- Receiving record reviewed by Gordon Castillo at 10:05; no shortage was recorded.

errors.explanation: The carrier terms require an itemized dollar value for damaged goods in the claim record, but this follow-up only says the damage notice will be submitted. Add the total value of the six broken planters to the claim record.
errors.fix: Follow-up: Wendy Gallagher will submit the carrier damage notice with the itemized dollar value of the six broken planters.
